offering_description.value: Designs, sources and markets apparel, outerwear, footwear and accessories under owned and licensed brands. Sells mainly to department stores, specialty and off-price retailers, and online, and licenses its brands to other companies.

primary_products.value: outerwear; dresses; sportswear; handbags and accessories; footwear; swimwear

customer_segment.value: B2B: department stores, specialty and off-price retailers, mass merchants, online retailers; B2C: consumers buying through own outlet stores and online channels

end_markets.value: apparel retail; department stores; specialty retail; e-commerce; off-price retail

revenue_model.value: product sales: apparel, footwear and accessories sold wholesale to retailers and through own stores; licensing or royalties: royalties from licensees that make and sell products under its brands

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs and markets owned and licensed brands, using contract manufacturers, sold to retailers; retailer: operates outlet stores and online sales directly to consumers

geography_served.value: global: mainly United States and Canada, with international sales and licensees in Europe and Asia

specialization.value: related lines: apparel, outerwear, footwear and accessories sharing retail customers and brand licensing

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to major department and specialty retail accounts; own locations: company-operated outlet stores selling excess and branded merchandise; online: company websites and e-commerce sales of branded products; third-party retail: department stores, specialty chains, off-price and mass retailers; partners / resellers: licensees and international partners that sell products under its brands
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; own locations; online; third-party retail; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: product safety, textile labeling, customs and tariff rules for imported apparel from CPSC and CBP
